author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Ham leg on the diagonal: a smooth teardrop of meat with its round end at the bottom left, an outlined bone shaft at 45 degrees ending in a round knob in the top-right corner, and a cut-face ring in the meat. No Lucide ham; drumstick construction.
omissions: The two-lobed bone end is a single round knob (two small lobes leave undersized holes at a 4-unit stroke); the reference's large cut-face ellipse and inner marrow are reduced to one ring (8-unit spacing).
